summary: Fixed itermonomials scalar min_degrees filtering to compare the sum of exponents with the minimum total degree in both commutative and noncommutative branches. Added exact cubic and degree 2-to-3 regression tests covering commutative, noncommutative, and mixed variables. Public test_monomials.py reproduced both new failures before the fix (11 passed, 2 failed); after the fix all 13 passed using /opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/bin/python bin/test sympy/polys/tests/test_monomials.py --no-colors --no-subprocess. Reviewed final diff; no full-suite or hidden tests run.
